description: This Java class 'GenreStatistics' extends 'Statistics' and provides methods to analyze genres of books, such as finding the most read genre, most liked genre, and least liked genre based on ratings. It processes a list of books from a reading shelf to generate statistical insights about book genres.

classes.name: GenreStatistics
classes.description: A class that computes statistics related to book genres in a reading collection.

methods.name: findMostReadGenre
methods.description: Returns the genre most frequently read, if any, as an Optional.

methods.name: findMostLikedGenre
methods.description: Returns the genre with the highest total rating across read books as an Optional.

methods.name: findLeastLikedGenre
methods.description: Returns the genre with the lowest total rating across read books as an Optional.
